entries.title: II Corinthians 2:1
segments: ¶But it was my decision for myself, not to come again to you with sorrow.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:2
segments: For if I give you sorrow, who then will make me glad, but he who is made sad by me?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:3
segments: And I said this very thing in my letter, for fear that when I came I might have sorrow from those from whom it was right for me to have joy; being certain of this, that my joy is the joy of you all.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:4
segments: For out of much trouble and pain of heart and much weeping I sent my letter to you; not to give you sorrow, but so that you might see how great is the love which I have to you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:5
segments: ¶But if anyone has been a cause of sorrow, he has been so, not to me only, but in some measure to all of you (I say this that I may not be over-hard on you).

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:6
segments: Let it be enough for such a man to have undergone the punishment which the church put on him;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:7
segments: So that now, on the other hand, it is right for him to have forgiveness and comfort from you, for fear that his sorrow may be over-great.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:8
segments: For which cause my desire is that you will make your love to him clear by your acts.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:9
segments: And for the same reason I sent you a letter so that I might be certain of your desire to do my orders in all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:10
segments: But if you give forgiveness to anyone, I do the same: for if I have given forgiveness for anything, I have done it because of you, in the person of Christ;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:11
segments: So that Satan may not get the better of us: for we are not without knowledge of his designs.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:12
segments: ¶Now when I came to Troas for the good news of Christ, and there was an open door for me in the Lord,

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:13
segments: I had no rest in my spirit because Titus my brother was not there: so I went away from them, and came into Macedonia.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:14
segments: But praise be to God who makes us strong to overcome in Christ, and makes clear through us in every place the value of the knowledge of him.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:15
segments: For we are a sweet perfume of Christ to God in those who are getting salvation and in those who are going to destruction;

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:16
segments: To the one it is a perfume of death to death; to the other a perfume of life to life. And who is enough for such things?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:17
segments: For we are not like the great number who make use of the word of God for profit: but our words are true, as from God, being said as before God in Christ.
